origins.SUITE: Shared with the other Anne's Office apps (shell, files, AI providers, recovery)
origins.ARC: Archival practice (accession and custody records, original order, arrangement and description, finding aids, appraisal, restrictions)
origins.DP: Digital-preservation practice (fixity, format identification and format risk, migration, preservation events, packaging)
origins.BAK: Backup practice (several copies on different media in different places, verify after writing, restore drills, media rotation)
origins.RM: Records-management practice (retention rules, holds, review, release with a record)
origins.LIB: Library cataloguing practice (descriptive fields, agreed forms of names, subject lists)
origins.RCV: Data-recovery practice (disk images, read-only handling, salvage of damaged files, old encodings)
origins.EST: Estate and succession practice (inventories, letters of instruction, handing files to heirs and successors)

tabs.name: File
tabs.description: Create, open, save, protect, print and close holdings; the holding's policy; options

commands.label: New Holding…
commands.notes: an empty holding: no items, no places

commands.label: New Holding from Folder…
commands.notes: every file under a folder becomes an item where it lies; nothing is moved or changed; the subfolders become the first arrangement

commands.label: New Holding from Template…
commands.notes: family archive, household papers, a writer's or researcher's files, a small organization's records, a photograph collection, a finished project; each sets a copy rule, an audit interval and lasting-format choices that you can change

commands.label: New Holding from Manifest…
commands.notes: starts from a checksum list or a packaged folder made elsewhere, and verifies it first

commands.label: New Holding for Someone Else's Files…
commands.notes: for files that came to you after a death or a handover; records who gave you what and when, before anything is opened

commands.label: Open…
commands.notes: recognizes the format by content

commands.label: Open and Repair…
commands.notes: rebuilds a damaged holding from its journal and from the catalog copies kept at each place; see ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md

commands.label: Open in New Window
commands.notes: two holdings side by side

commands.label: Save
commands.notes: every change is journaled as it is made; Save writes the file

commands.label: Save Catalog to Every Place
commands.notes: writes the current catalog beside each reachable copy, so that the holding can be rebuilt from any place that survives

commands.label: Versions…
commands.notes: named snapshots of the catalog; compare or restore

commands.label: Export…
commands.notes: see FORMATS-PLAN.md

commands.label: Send…
commands.notes: through Anne's Post or the system share sheet

commands.label: Holding Properties…
commands.notes: title, whose files these are, what the holding is for, who looks after it

commands.label: Holding Policy…
commands.notes: the copy rule, the audit interval, which formats count as lasting, and which risks count as High

commands.label: Holding Statistics
commands.notes: items by status and by format, total size, copies by place, risks by kind, audits done and due

commands.label: Protect Holding…
commands.notes: password encryption of the catalog file; the items themselves are not touched

tabs.name: Home
tabs.description: Editing basics and the everyday loop: go to the next thing that needs attention and deal with it

commands.label: Cut
commands.notes: in descriptions and notes

commands.label: Copy Description
commands.notes: the selected item's catalog entry as text

commands.label: Copy Fingerprint
commands.notes: the SHA-256 of the selected item, for comparing by hand or for sending to someone who holds a copy

commands.label: Paste Description
commands.notes: applies copied catalog fields to the selected items; what would be overwritten is listed first

commands.label: Undo
commands.notes: undoes changes to the catalog; a copy already written to a place is removed only by its own command

commands.label: History…
commands.notes: the journal: who changed what and when

commands.label: Find…
commands.notes: in the active pane

commands.label: Find in Whole Holding…
commands.notes: names, descriptions, the text inside items, notes, formats and fingerprints at once

commands.label: Replace…
commands.notes: in descriptions and notes only; items are never changed

commands.label: Go To…
commands.notes: an item number, a place, a date

commands.label: Select Similar
commands.notes: every item with the same format, status, risk or place as the selected one

commands.label: Next Item Needing Attention
commands.notes: the next Damaged, Missing, At Risk or Stale item, worst first

commands.label: Next Undescribed Item
commands.notes: no title, no date or no description

commands.label: Show Copies of Item
commands.notes: where every copy of the selected item is, and when each was last verified

commands.label: Due Today
commands.notes: audits, places to verify, holds that end and keep-until dates that have been reached

tabs.name: Take In
tabs.description: Bring files, folders, old disks, accounts and other people's papers into the holding, and record where each came from

commands.label: Add Files…
commands.notes: the files stay where they are; each is fingerprinted and never altered

commands.label: Watch Folder…
commands.notes: new and changed files in a folder are offered to the holding; nothing is taken in silently

commands.label: Add from Scanner or Camera…
commands.notes: through Anne's Lens; the original image is kept

commands.label: Add from Another Device…
commands.notes: a phone, a camera, a card or a drive; lists what is new since the last time

commands.label: Add Mailbox…
commands.notes: a mailbox file, or an account folder through Anne's Post; messages and attachments become items in a group

commands.label: Capture Web Site…
commands.notes: saves pages as they are now, with their pictures and the time, through Anne's Loom; for your own site or for pages you rely on

commands.label: Add Account Export…
commands.notes: the archive file a web service gives you when you ask for your data; its parts are listed and identified

commands.label: Add Item with No File…
commands.notes: a box, an album, a tape, a paper file; described and located like any other item, so that the holding also covers what is not digital

commands.label: Read Disk Image…
commands.notes: opens an image of a floppy disk, a hard disk, a card or an optical disc read-only and lists its files, including deleted ones that the suite recovery engines can find

commands.label: Make Disk Image…
commands.notes: desktop builds; copies a whole card or drive to an image file before anything else is done, and fingerprints it

commands.label: Open Archive File…
commands.notes: ZIP, TAR and older archive formats; damaged ones through the suite's ZIP salvage; the archive stays an item and its contents become parts

commands.label: Old Text Encodings…
commands.notes: file names and text in older character sets shown correctly; the bytes are not changed

commands.label: Unidentified Files…
commands.notes: the files no rule could identify, with what is known about each: first bytes, readable strings, size, date, neighbors

commands.label: Accession Record…
commands.notes: what came in, from whom, when and on what terms; one record for each batch

commands.label: Custody Note…
commands.notes: who held these files before you and how they reached you

commands.label: Keep Original Order
commands.notes: the folder layout as it arrived is recorded, however the items are arranged later

commands.label: Mark as Held for Someone Else…
commands.notes: files you hold for another person; their wishes and how to reach them are recorded

commands.label: Find Duplicates
commands.notes: identical files by fingerprint; the same content in different containers is listed separately as likely duplicates

commands.label: Find Versions
commands.notes: drafts and later saves of the same work, by name, date and shared content; grouped, never merged

commands.label: Group as One Item…
commands.notes: files that make sense only together: a page layout and its pictures, a web site folder, a database and its attachments

commands.label: Leave Out…
commands.notes: patterns for files that are never taken in: caches, thumbnails, system files; the list is shown and can be changed

commands.label: Refresh from Disk
commands.notes: re-reads the folders the holding covers; new, changed, moved and vanished files are listed

tabs.name: Describe
tabs.description: Say what each thing is, so that someone who never met you can find it and understand it

commands.label: Description…
commands.notes: title, who made it, dates, what it is, how much there is, language

commands.label: People and Organizations…
commands.notes: names in one agreed form with their variants kept; can be linked to persons in an Anne's Chart tree

commands.label: Places Named…
commands.notes: the places an item is about, as distinct from the places where its copies are stored

commands.label: Dates…
commands.notes: exact, approximate, a range, or before and after; the file's own dates are kept separately and never overwritten

commands.label: Rights and Restrictions…
commands.notes: who holds the rights as far as you know, who may see the item and from when

commands.label: Fill Down
commands.notes: copies a field to the selected items

commands.label: Arrangement
commands.notes: the holding as groups within groups; an item appears once, wherever its files are

commands.label: Move to Group…
commands.notes: changes the arrangement only; no file moves

commands.label: Inherit Description
commands.notes: a group's creator, dates, rights and restrictions apply to everything in it unless an item says otherwise

commands.label: Number Items…
commands.notes: reference numbers that stay the same when items are rearranged

commands.label: Sort and Filter…
commands.notes: by status, format, date, place, group, risk or any catalog field

commands.label: Read Embedded Details
commands.notes: titles, authors, dates, captions, keywords and map positions already inside the files, shown beside your own description

commands.label: Use Embedded Details…
commands.notes: copies chosen fields into the catalog; the file is not changed

commands.label: Describe from File Names…
commands.notes: a pattern pulls dates, numbers and names out of file and folder names

commands.label: Recognize Text (OCR)
commands.notes: the suite OCR engine; the text is an aid for search, the picture stays the item

commands.label: Extract Text for Search
commands.notes: through the sister apps' readers

commands.label: Link to Person in Tree…
commands.notes: an Anne's Chart person or a GEDCOM record

commands.label: Description Check
commands.notes: items with no title, no date, no creator or no rights note; groups about which nothing is said

commands.label: Name Authority…
commands.notes: merges spellings of the same person, place or organization

commands.label: Controlled Lists…
commands.notes: your own lists of subjects, record types and places

commands.label: Mark as Confidential
commands.notes: left out of handover packets unless you say otherwise, and out of every AI request

tabs.name: Assess
tabs.description: Tests the app computes itself, without AI: what is this, does it open, is it whole, what threatens it

commands.label: Assess All
commands.notes: every check below; results in the Risks pane

commands.label: Assess on Take-In
commands.notes: toggle; default on

commands.label: Stop Assessment
commands.notes: long runs can be paused and resumed

commands.label: Identify Format
commands.notes: by content: signatures and structure, not the file extension; the rule that matched is shown

commands.label: Extension Mismatch
commands.notes: files whose name says one format and whose content is another

commands.label: Format Census
commands.notes: how many items and how much data there are in each format and version

commands.label: Format Notes
commands.notes: for the selected format: whether its specification is public, what reads it, what it depends on, how old it is

commands.label: Open Check
commands.notes: each item is read by the suite's reader for its type; items that fail, or that open only in part, are listed with the reason

commands.label: Structure Check
commands.notes: the format's own rules: a well-formed container, a complete index, lengths that agree with what is stated

commands.label: Lock Check
commands.notes: passwords, encryption and usage restrictions; such items cannot be kept readable without the key

commands.label: Dependency Check
commands.notes: fonts that are not embedded, pictures and data linked from other files, macros, pages that load from the web

commands.label: Completeness Check
commands.notes: a group has every part it refers to; a numbered series has no gaps

commands.label: Fixity Check
commands.notes: every reachable copy is hashed again and compared with its recorded fingerprint

commands.label: Damage Report
commands.notes: for an item that no longer matches or no longer opens: which part is affected and which copy is intact

commands.label: Date Check
commands.notes: file dates, embedded dates and described dates that cannot all be right

commands.label: Format Risk
commands.notes: each format rated from stated facts in the format register, with the reasons listed

commands.label: Copy Rule Check
commands.notes: items with fewer copies, fewer kinds of medium or fewer places than the policy asks for

commands.label: Media Age Check
commands.notes: copies on media older than the service life you set for that kind

commands.label: File Name Check
commands.notes: names that will not survive a move to another system: reserved characters, length, names that differ only by case, mixed Unicode forms

commands.label: Single Point Check
commands.notes: everything that would be lost if one named place, device, account or password were lost

commands.label: Stranger Test
commands.notes: for each item: could a person with no special software read it, with a text editor, a web browser or an unzip tool? The share of the holding that passes is shown

commands.label: Risk Details…
commands.notes: what the risk is, the facts it rests on, and the commands that would reduce it

commands.label: Accept Risk…
commands.notes: you decide to live with a risk; the reason is recorded, and the risk is shown again at every audit

commands.label: Edit Format Register…
commands.notes: the facts behind Format Risk are data that you can read, correct and date

tabs.name: Copies
tabs.description: Where the copies are, what they are on, and whether each one is still good

commands.label: Places…
commands.notes: every place a copy can live: this device, a drive, a disc, a cloud folder, a safe, another person's house

commands.label: New Place…
commands.notes: name, kind of medium, where it is, who can reach it, when it went into service

commands.label: Mark Place as Away from Home
commands.notes: counts toward the away-from-home part of the copy rule

commands.label: Retire Place…
commands.notes: lists what would be left with too few copies, and refuses until those are copied elsewhere or you say otherwise

commands.label: Send Copy To…
commands.notes: writes the selected items to a place, reads them back and compares them before the copy is counted

commands.label: Complete the Copy Rule…
commands.notes: works out the fewest copies to write, and where, so that every item meets the policy

commands.label: Write Manifest
commands.notes: a plain-text list of file names and fingerprints beside the copy, readable and checkable without this app

commands.label: Copy for a Person…
commands.notes: a chosen part of the holding for one relative or colleague, with its own index

commands.label: Move Copy…
commands.notes: copy, verify, then remove the old one; never the other way round

commands.label: Verify Place
commands.notes: hashes every file at a place and compares; can be run on any device the place is attached to

commands.label: Verify by Sample…
commands.notes: a random share of a large place now, and the rest over the following runs

commands.label: Compare Two Places
commands.notes: what one has that the other lacks, and what differs

commands.label: Restore Drill…
commands.notes: brings a sample back from a place to a scratch folder and opens it, to show that the copy can really be used

commands.label: Record Outside Check…
commands.notes: someone else verified a copy with its manifest and told you the result

commands.label: Heal from Another Copy
commands.notes: replaces a damaged copy with a verified intact one; the damaged file is set aside, not deleted, until you say so

commands.label: Find Moved Files
commands.notes: files that were renamed or moved are recognized by fingerprint and relinked

commands.label: Report Lost Place…
commands.notes: a drive failed, a disc is unreadable, an account was closed: every copy there is marked gone and the copy rule is checked again

commands.label: Recovery Records…
commands.notes: extra data stored beside a copy, from which a limited amount of damage can be repaired without another copy

commands.label: Audit Schedule…
commands.notes: how often each place is verified; reminders through Anne's Post or the system calendar

commands.label: Run Audit Now
commands.notes: verifies what is due, assesses the risks again and writes an audit record

commands.label: Audit Records
commands.notes: every audit: who ran it, what was checked, what was found, what was done

commands.label: Media Log…
commands.notes: each drive and disc: bought, first used, errors seen, replaced

tabs.name: Renditions
tabs.description: Make copies in formats likely to stay readable, and test that each one still says what the original says

commands.label: Rendition Plan…
commands.notes: for the selection: which formats would be made from which, by which writer, what each is known to lose, and the space needed

commands.label: Lasting Formats…
commands.notes: the holding's choice of target format for each kind of content

commands.label: Dry Run
commands.notes: converts a sample and reports the comparison before anything is added to the holding

commands.label: What Would Be Lost…
commands.notes: the known limits of a conversion, stated before it runs: the features the target format cannot hold

commands.label: Make Rendition…
commands.notes: writes a new file in a lasting format through the sister app that owns the type; the original is kept and never changed

commands.label: Make Plain-Text Rendition
commands.notes: the words alone, in UTF-8, as the rendition of last resort

commands.label: Make Page-Image Rendition
commands.notes: one picture for each page, for documents whose look matters and whose format is at risk

commands.label: Make Reading Copy…
commands.notes: a small, convenient copy for everyday use, kept apart from the preservation copy

commands.label: Embed What It Depends On…
commands.notes: a rendition with its fonts, linked pictures and linked data inside it

commands.label: Make File Names Safe…
commands.notes: safe names for the renditions or for a copy; the original names are kept in the catalog

commands.label: Batch Make…
commands.notes: runs a plan over many items; can be paused and resumed

commands.label: Sameness Check
commands.notes: compares a rendition with its original by content: words, page count, pixels, cell values and formula results, rows, playing time; no AI

commands.label: Loss Statement
commands.notes: what the comparison found different, item by item, in plain words

commands.label: Accept Loss…
commands.notes: you decide that a rendition is good enough; the differences you accepted are recorded with it

commands.label: Reject Rendition
commands.notes: the rendition is removed from the holding and the reason is kept

commands.label: View Side by Side
commands.notes: original and rendition together, with the differences marked

commands.label: Round-Trip Check
commands.notes: convert, convert back, and compare with the original

commands.label: Repair Item…
commands.notes: hands a damaged file to the suite recovery engine of its type; the repaired file is added as a rendition and the damaged original stays

commands.label: Recover Text Only
commands.notes: whatever words can still be read from a file that will not open

commands.label: Recover Pictures Only
commands.notes: through Anne's Lens

commands.label: Repair Report
commands.notes: what was recovered, what was not, and how the repaired file differs from the damaged one

commands.label: Rendition Lineage
commands.notes: which file was made from which, by what tool and version, and when

commands.label: Replace Rendition…
commands.notes: a better conversion exists; the earlier one is kept in history

commands.label: Set as Preservation Copy
commands.notes: which file of an item the copy rule and the audits protect first

tabs.name: Retain
tabs.description: Decide how long to keep things, hold what must not go, and let go on the record

commands.label: Keep Until…
commands.notes: a date, an event (so many years after filing, when a matter closes) or always

commands.label: Retention Rules…
commands.notes: rules by group or record type; the app ships with none that state a legal period

commands.label: Why Is This Kept?
commands.notes: the rule, hold or note that explains an item's keep-until date

commands.label: Worth Keeping…
commands.notes: a recorded judgment of the lasting value of an item or group, and the reason

commands.label: Place Hold…
commands.notes: nothing under a hold can be released or have its copies reduced, whatever its date

commands.label: Lift Hold…
commands.notes: records who lifted it and why

commands.label: Due for Review
commands.notes: items whose keep-until date has passed; nothing happens to them without you

commands.label: Release…
commands.notes: a decision not to keep an item any longer; the reason, the date and the fingerprint stay in the catalog

commands.label: Release Duplicates…
commands.notes: only byte-identical files, only after a fresh fixity check, and never the last copy

commands.label: Remove Released Files…
commands.notes: deletes the files of released items from the places you choose, after a count and a confirmation

commands.label: Release Record
commands.notes: a list of what was released, when, by whom and why, with fingerprints

commands.label: Restore Released Item
commands.notes: possible while a copy still exists anywhere

commands.label: Transfer Out…
commands.notes: the item went to someone else: a relative, an archive, a successor; the holding remembers where

commands.label: Restrict Until…
commands.notes: not to be opened or passed on before a date or an event

commands.label: Living People…
commands.notes: marks items about living people by the suite's rule, so that they can be left out of what is shared

commands.label: Sensitive Patterns…
commands.notes: account numbers, identity numbers and the like, found on the device by the app's own pattern rules

tabs.name: Hand Over
tabs.description: Make the holding usable by someone else: a guide, a packet, a deposit, and a plain account of what is here and how to open it

commands.label: Finding Aid…
commands.notes: the arrangement with its descriptions, as a document a stranger can read from the top

commands.label: Item List…
commands.notes: every item with its number, title, dates, format, size and where its copies are; to Anne's Grid, PDF or print

commands.label: Format Guide…
commands.notes: for each format in the holding: what it is, what opens it today, and where its specification is published

commands.label: Where Everything Is…
commands.notes: every place, what is there and who can reach it; no passwords are written

commands.label: Build Handover Packet…
commands.notes: a folder that explains itself: a guide as plain text and as a web page that open on any computer, the item list, and the chosen files with their manifest

commands.label: Letter to Whoever Opens This…
commands.notes: your own words: what this is, what matters most, what may be thrown away, whom to ask

commands.label: Keys and Passwords Note…
commands.notes: which items are locked and where the key is kept; the app records the whereabouts, not the key

commands.label: Wishes…
commands.notes: who should receive which group; this is not a will, and the packet says so

commands.label: Test Packet as a Stranger
commands.notes: opens the packet with the holding closed and reports what could not be understood or opened

commands.label: Package for Deposit…
commands.notes: a package with manifests and descriptive data in the published BagIt layout, for an archive, a library or a successor

commands.label: Export Catalog…
commands.notes: the descriptions as CSV, JSON or XML with commonly used field names

commands.label: Gift Checklist…
commands.notes: what you are giving and on what terms; a checklist, not a legal document

commands.label: Record Receipt…
commands.notes: the receiver verified the manifest and reported back; the transfer is recorded

commands.label: Condition Report…
commands.notes: the status of every item, the open risks, the accepted risks and the last audit, on one page and in full

commands.label: Copy Map Report…
commands.notes: items against places, as a table or as a diagram through Anne's Chart

commands.label: Change Report…
commands.notes: what changed in the holding between two dates

commands.label: Rendition Report…
commands.notes: every rendition, what it was made from, its comparison and the losses accepted

tabs.name: Review
tabs.description: Look after a holding with other people: comment, assign, sign off, combine

commands.label: New Comment
commands.notes: on an item, a group, a place or a risk

commands.label: Mark Described
commands.notes: a person vouches for the description of an item or group

commands.label: Mark Checked
commands.notes: a second person confirms an accepted loss, an accepted risk or a release; cleared automatically if the item changes afterward

commands.label: Review Queue
commands.notes: decisions waiting for you

commands.label: Two-Person Rule…
commands.notes: optional: releases and removals need a second person's sign-off

commands.label: Compare Holdings…
commands.notes: differences between two copies of a holding

commands.label: Merge Holdings…
commands.notes: two people's catalogs of overlapping files, matched by fingerprint, with conflicting descriptions listed

commands.label: Split Holding…
commands.notes: a group becomes a holding of its own, for dividing an estate or handing off a project

commands.label: Import Descriptions…
commands.notes: from another holding, matched by fingerprint

tabs.name: View
tabs.description: Panes, layouts and pictures of the holding

commands.label: Shelf
commands.notes: the arrangement on the left, the items in the middle, description and status on the right

commands.label: Item View
commands.notes: one item shown through the suite's reader for its type, with its copies, renditions and risks

commands.label: Risk Board
commands.notes: items in columns by status, or risks by kind

commands.label: Copy Map
commands.notes: items down, places across, a mark where a verified copy lies

commands.label: Calendar
commands.notes: audits, reviews, holds and restrictions by date

commands.label: Lineage View
commands.notes: originals, renditions and repaired files, and what was made from what

commands.label: Timeline View
commands.notes: items by the dates they describe

commands.label: Folder View
commands.notes: the files as they lie on disk at one place

commands.label: Split View
commands.notes: two items, or an original and its rendition, side by side

commands.label: Status Marks…
commands.notes: a mark, a word and a color for each status; marks are on by default so that color is not the only signal

commands.label: Menus
commands.notes: ribbon, classic menu bar, or both

commands.label: Add All Choices to Quick Access Bar
Theme
commands.notes: light, dark, high contrast, system

tabs.name: Tools
tabs.description: Macros, batch work and connections to the other apps

commands.label: Rules…
commands.notes: your own checks: a pattern, a comparison and a message (for example, every item in one group needs two places away from home)

commands.label: Background Work…
commands.notes: hashing, copying and converting in progress; pause, resume, reorder

commands.label: Send Item List to Anne's Grid
Keep the Sources of a Case…
commands.notes: takes the sources of an Anne's Witness case into the holding and keeps the case's fingerprints in step with the holding's

commands.label: Keep a Family Tree's Media…
commands.notes: the pictures and documents a tree file refers to, with their links to persons

commands.label: Import…
commands.notes: see FORMATS-PLAN.md

commands.label: Hash Calculator…
commands.notes: fingerprints of any file by several algorithms, and comparison with a pasted value

commands.notes: checks any folder against any checksum list, with or without a holding

commands.label: Spelling…
commands.notes: in descriptions and notes

tabs.name: AI
tabs.description: Optional helpers that describe, sort and draft. They propose; they never decide, and they never touch a file. See AI-PLAN.md

commands.label: Ask the Holding…
commands.notes: answers only from the catalog and the text of the items; every sentence names its items, and "not in this holding" is a normal answer

commands.label: Describe Picture

commands.label: Translate Description

commands.label: Find Related Items

commands.label: Suggest Record Types

commands.label: Screen for Private Information
